expected_behavior_change: Admin Cloud publish admission is ordered by publish time instead of diagnostic revision number.
A newer Admin publish may supersede an older SMT/Admin state even when its Rxx number is lower.
SMT applies canonical Admin envelopes by publishedAt plus fingerprint and never rejects solely because revision decreased.
SMT missed-doorbell recovery uses startup/reconnect/focus/pageshow/visibility events through the same canonical pull path, with no interval polling.
Admin only marks PUBLISHED after exact canonical response plus Cloud publish time evidence.
non_goals: No Order, Pricing, Payment, Print, Keeta, Customer, SMM or Owner authority change.
